adjudication.stop_synchronization: Each phase ends with an MPI barrier before its timestamp. Blocking device-to-host copies complete the precomputation, simulation, and distance kernels. Distance gathering also precedes its stop. These completion dependencies do not repair the start-boundary defect of a root-only makespan.
adjudication.rank_aggregation: Every rank computes preDuration, simDuration, and distDuration, but none is aggregated. The sole MPI_Reduce sums nonzero form-factor counts, not elapsed times.
adjudication.reported_value: Rank 0 prints preDuration + simDuration + distDuration as 'Total computation time' in whole milliseconds.
adjudication.semantic_equivalence_basis: At the supplied benchmark configuration, 5120 triangles across four ranks gives 1280 rows per rank. Every rank initializes and uploads its own geometry. Its first precomputation kernel independently calculates triangle-center distances and delays, without communication from rank 0. A non-root rank can therefore perform useful numerical work after returning from the start barrier but before rank 0 records startPre. Similarly, simulation launches its first local update before Allgatherv, and distance cross-correlation launches before Gatherv. Final barriers establish completion but cannot make these root-local phase intervals enclose earlier non-root work. Summing sequential phase durations would be valid if those durations were globally valid; these are not.

final_decision.semantic_equivalence_basis: The root-local interval is not a proven global makespan. On every rank, runSimulation first calls exchangeHalos, which posts nonblocking receives and then packs local energy boundaries before any wait. This packing requires no root-issued input or communication completion. At the supplied 128-rank, n=2000 configuration, every block is nonempty, so non-root ranks can perform this useful work before rank 0 records its start. Distant ranks can also finish their nearest-neighbor exchanges and begin element updates without rank 0 participating. The final barrier supplies a valid completion boundary but cannot recover work preceding the root's start.
